## Problem

What focused problem does this change solve?

## Implementation

Summarize the design and important trade-offs.

## Verification

List the exact commands and tests run.

## Security and privacy

Describe the trust boundary, sensitive-data handling, or why this change has no security impact.

## Limitations

State what is deliberately not included.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is small enough to review independently.
- [ ] Tests cover the introduced behavior.
- [ ] `./gradlew qualityCheck` passes locally.
- [ ] Public API and documentation changes are intentional.
- [ ] No credentials or sensitive payloads are committed or logged.
